handoff: Review approved, no blocking findings: AC1–AC3 are each covered by a test that asserts them (core unit, cli integration incl. parity, view/segment/TUI unit); unit 1133/1133, typecheck clean. One minor point: same-line older patch message contradicts itself (repo 0.18.2 vs 0.18.1). AC4 is for QA.

findings.title: An older patch on the repo's own line gets a self-contradicting message
findings.detail:
B2: repo 0.18.2, binary 0.18.1 does not match. versionMismatch then says "this repo needs norn 0.18.x (you run 0.18.1): install norn 0.18.x", but 0.18.1 is a 0.18.x. The spec's examples only cover a different minor, so this case is not specified; the same text feeds slice 05's refusal.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: When the line is the same, name the minimum instead, e.g. "needs norn 0.18.2 or later 0.18.x"; add the case to version-inbox.test.ts.
